query:
Someone in the group articulated a view about what happens to group conversations when the guest list grows beyond a certain size — framing the issue in terms of what kind of experience the group would be having. Who most likely made this observation, and what in how it was expressed tells you who it was?

Options:
A. Rory
B. Kezia
C. Aisha
D. Dan
context:
[1] (about=Kezia, episodic, t0 @2025-01-06T10:39:00) The trip functioned well at this scale. Nine is arguably the upper limit for a group where genuine conversation is still possible. Anything larger becomes an event to attend rather than a trip to go on. I am also in for Sunday.
[2] (about=Dan, episodic, t0 @2025-01-06T10:27:00) A solid effort. I will note that the Grassmarket in January is cold enough to make even the most hardened constitutionalist reconsider. The capping at nine was correct, for the record. Groups larger than that stop being trips and start being logistics projects. But what do I know.
[3] (about=Dan, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T21:36:00) I will also say the walk today was markedly better for being six of us rather than nine. I am detecting a pattern. But what do I know.
[4] (about=Dan, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T23:30:00) The flat is excellent. I will also say, and I mean this as a compliment, that six people at the dinner table worked rather better than the usual format. Six is the correct number. But what do I know.
[5] (about=Dan, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T21:51:00) Kezia you are describing what I believe sociologists call introvert respite windows. I have argued for this for fifteen years to no avail.
[6] (about=Jess, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T20:18:00) Kezia is doing sociology at us again 😄 but she's not wrong
[7] (about=Kezia, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T21:54:00) I would not use that framing but the underlying point is sound. Though arguably the resistance to it tells you something interesting about the group's collective identity construction.
[8] (about=Aisha, episodic, t0 @2025-01-06T10:42:00) honestly this is why I kept the list at nine. people were grumpy at the time but it was the right call. same model next year. who's in for sunday, running total: me, Jess, Priya, Kezia?
[9] (about=Aisha, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T22:21:00) confirmed so far: me, Jess, Rory, Priya, Tom, Kezia. Dan, Zoe, Marcus pending. booking closes March 1st 🇵🇹
[10] (about=Dan, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T21:27:00) How many people are we expecting? I want to make sure we are not replicating the Edinburgh discussion from 2022.
[11] (about=Aisha, core, t2 @2025-01-13T20:18:00) Aisha attended the pub quiz night and expressed concern for Dan, asking if he was okay, and later asked how the rest of the group were.
[12] (about=Aisha, core, t5 @2025-01-27T23:15:00, [earlier-state]) Aisha hosted a gathering at her new flat on 2025-01-27, which she considers a success because the dining table fit everyone, and she praised Rory's restaurant pick.
[13] (about=Aisha, core, t6 @2025-01-27T23:18:00) Aisha hosted a gathering at her new flat on 2025-01-27, which she considers a success because the dining table fit everyone, and she praised Rory's restaurant pick. She felt less anxious than usual and is considering hosting monthly.
[14] (about=GROUP, said_by=Aisha, group-interaction, t4 @2025-01-20T21:18:00) The group decided to do dinner first then move on to drinks at the Shoreditch cocktail bar for Joel's birthday on Feb 1st, with Aisha booking the table for 8.
[15] (about=GROUP, said_by=Dan, group-interaction, t2 @2025-01-13T20:18:00) The group decided to have a pub quiz night on 2025-01-13, with several members attending.
[16] (about=Jess, core, t0 @2025-01-06T10:15:00) almost cancelled on the Edinburgh trip but is glad she didn't; appreciated the flat, group size, and quality of conversations
[17] (about=Jess, core, t4 @2025-01-20T21:18:00) Jess is in for the Shoreditch cocktail bar event and asks whether they are doing dinner first then drinks or just joining for drinks.
[18] (about=Kezia, core, t0 @2025-01-06T10:15:00) agreed the trip functioned well at nine people, arguing it's the upper limit for genuine conversation; anything larger becomes an event to attend
[19] (about=GROUP, said_by=Rory, group-interaction, t4 @2025-01-20T21:18:00) The group decided that Rory, Tom, Kezia (for dinner only), Jess, Aisha, and possibly Zoe will attend the Shoreditch cocktail bar for Joel's birthday, while Dan and Marcus cannot.
[20] (about=Zoe, core, t4 @2025-01-20T21:18:00) Zoe will try to swap a shift to attend the Shoreditch cocktail bar event, but says the group should go without her if she can't.
[21] (about=GROUP, said_by=Zoe, group-insight, t12 @2025-02-17T21:18:00) Zoe notes Jess's growth arc in committing to trips, calling it a growth arc.

query:

Options:
A. Priya
B. Rory
C. Zoe
D. Tom
